name: make-the-join-safe
problem: The merge-pressure round proved the join unsafe: branch-parallel link ops corrupt the journal (colliding dense ids, tombstone races decided by union line order) and every merge forces a hand edit of the hand-edit-banned file; colliding saves have no verb-shaped repair — the later writer retypes the note, closes nothing, and the round record silently claims the winner's version; and a merge's semantic delta is invisible until the next save seals it. Three of the round's four derived requirements land here (rounds-fold-deliberately stays open: session folding needs schema design).

technology_stack.tech: Rust 2024; crates/archi: links/mod.rs + links/capture.rs (content-suffixed link ids l<seq>-<hex6>, absorbing order-independent fold with surfaced notes, self-healed archi/links/.gitattributes merge=union), versions.rs (remint, diff with a live target, recipe-naming E_ARCHIVE messages, artifact list on mint), docs/mod.rs (restamp_session; session id validation skips only when the archive itself is unreadable), main.rs (dispatch + usage)
technology_stack.provenance: every change extends a proven seam: fold(), save(), stamp_closed() and Model::render_source() already exist; sha2 already in the dependency tree for the id suffix; the versions .gitattributes self-heal is the precedent for the journal's

architecture_summary.role: the append-only truth learns to fold concurrent histories instead of corrupting on them
grows remint (mint + re-stamp the round) and live diffs; its diagnostics name their recipes

scenarios: two clones each link add on their own branch; git merges the journal via the shipped union attribute with no conflict; link ls shows both links live and verify is green in either union order

two clones each version save v0007; the integrator keeps the first-lander, runs version remint -m <note> --session <slug>; the manifest stays dense and linear, version diff shows exactly the reminted delta, and the named session's closed: follows onto the new id
on the merged, still-unsaved tree, version diff v0006 live prints the semantic delta the merge composed — before any save seals it

tasks.description: remint rejoins the lineage; merge deltas reviewable; diagnostics name recipes
tasks.stack_details: versions.rs: remint() (save + refuse-on-unchanged + named-session restamp), diff live rendering via Model::render_source(), open()/read_file() error text gains conflict-marker and half-shipped-save recipes, Saved carries the artifact list main prints as one commit unit; docs/mod.rs: restamp_session(root, slug, id) beside stamp_closed, session id-existence checks skip when Archive::open errors; main.rs: remint dispatch, diff accepts live on either side, usage strings

docs-compile-with-the-model: session id-existence validation skips only when the archive itself fails to open (E_ARCHIVE already reported by check); with a readable archive every E_SESSION check is byte-identical — docs tests stay green
findings-never-block: absorbed-event notes and recipe hints surface as advisory text; only genuine corruption, seal breaks and unreadable archives exit nonzero
merge-deltas-are-reviewable: e2e: on a dirty tree version diff v0006 live prints exactly the unsaved semantic delta; version diff live v0006 reverses it; two archived ids behave exactly as before
provenance-anchors-post-hoc: anchor is untouched; its e2e suite stays green; remint on a dirty tree mints without provenance exactly like save
remint-rejoins-the-lineage: e2e (multiplayer_e2e.rs): two clones save colliding v0007s; keep the first-lander, version remint -m note --session <slug> mints the merged tree, re-stamps that session's closed: to the new id, and version list stays dense and linear
unit: remint refuses an unchanged model, an unknown session, and an open session — the restamp targets closed rounds only
stress-pins-versions: restamp rewrites only the closed: field; no verb touches a session's pinned version:
the-archive-is-sealed: remint writes through the same save path — seal verification and tamper tests stay green; the new diagnostics rephrase E_ARCHIVE messages and never relax a seal check
unchanged-saves-close-rounds: save's close ceremony is untouched; remint's restamp names a closed session explicitly and never rides the open-session close path
versions-mint-on-meaning: remint hashes the render and refuses an unchanged model — no token mints; save's unchanged arm is untouched

tasks.description: the fold survives a merge: collision-free ids, absorbing fold, union attribute
tasks.stack_details: mod.rs: mint_id(seq, spec, anchor) -> l<seq>-<hex6> (sha256 over content + mint moment, first 6 hex), fold() absorbs identical replayed lines and events on tombstoned ids into Folded.absorbed notes (surfaced by verify/audit), refuses only ids the journal never minted and true duplicate-id adds; append() self-heals archi/links/.gitattributes with journal.jsonl merge=union; capture.rs mints through the same helper

link-truth-is-append-only: absorption is read-side only — no verb or fold path rewrites or drops a journal line; retire + re-add still mints a fresh id and keeps the tombstone; the existing fold and journal tests stay green
the-fold-survives-a-merge: unit tests: two branch segments unioned in both orders fold to the same live set; retire-then-repin absorbs with a surfaced note; an identical duplicated add line absorbs; an event naming an id never minted still refuses the fold
e2e: two clones each link add on branches; the union attribute merges the journal without conflict markers and link ls shows both links — the content suffix makes parallel mints collision-free
